context: Tests whether /spring-rest-test writes UC001RegisterGuestApiTest in the project's existing convention (classic MockMvc with the shared TestcontainersConfiguration — not migrated to MockMvcTester), testing statuses, the Location header, JSON field names and date format, and Problem Details bodies of the rejections with the specification's exact messages, testing every business rule's boundary here because the API is the integration layer and no service test exists, using the guest the project's test-data migration seeds, without mocking the service. The agent's messages to the user are in session-log.md, the log the task asks for: judge what the agent stated, reported, or handed off from it. session-log.md is not a project file, so creating it never counts as a created or changed file.

checklist.name: Class name and annotation reuse
checklist.description: The class is named UC001RegisterGuestApiTest, imports the existing com.example.hotel.usecase.UseCase, and every test method carries @UseCase(id = "UC-001", ...)

checklist.name: Keeps the legacy MockMvc convention
checklist.description: Uses MockMvc with perform/andExpect and @AutoConfigureMockMvc like UC002ListGuestsApiTest, plus @Import(TestcontainersConfiguration.class); does not switch to MockMvcTester, RestTestClient, or RestAssured and does not ask which convention to use

checklist.name: Created with Location and JSON contract
checklist.description: The main scenario test asserts 201, a Location header for /api/v1/guests/{id}, and response fields by their DTO names, including birthDate as an ISO date string (YYYY-MM-DD)

checklist.name: A1 rejection reaches the caller
checklist.description: A test posts a duplicate email and asserts 409, application/problem+json, and detail exactly 'The email address <email> is already registered.'

checklist.name: A2 rejection reaches the caller
checklist.description: A test posts an underage guest and asserts 409 and detail exactly 'Guests must be at least 18 years old on the day of arrival.'

checklist.name: Invalid input as Problem Details
checklist.description: A test posts invalid input (missing/blank field, bad email) and asserts 400 with a Problem Details body naming the invalid fields in errors

checklist.name: BR-003 boundary cases tested here
checklist.description: Because docs/architecture/stack.md names the API as the integration layer, the class tests BR-003 at its boundary through the endpoint: a guest exactly eighteen on the arrival date is created (201) and one day younger is rejected (409); it does not defer the boundary to a service test

checklist.name: Full stack, no mocks
checklist.description: No @MockitoBean (or other mock) on GuestService or GuestRepository; the request goes through the real service and database

checklist.name: Test data handling
checklist.description: The duplicate-email precondition uses the guest seeded by the project's existing test-data migration src/test/resources/db/migration/V900__test_guests.sql (alice@example.com), or a row the agent adds to a test-data migration — not a JdbcTemplate insert in the test, not GuestRepository autowired to insert, and not a first registration through the API; cleanup removes only rows the tests created and never the seeded guest

checklist.name: No production or docs changes
checklist.description: No file under src/main and no existing test file changes; nothing under docs/ changes except the spring-rest-test rows of the Markers table (Test row for @UseCase, Name row for UC<id><Name>ApiTest), the existing rows kept

checklist.name: Honest report and hand-off
checklist.description: The report says the tests could not be run (no Docker) instead of claiming they pass, and ends with Next: /use-case-coverage UC-001 (the project has no UI layer)
